WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner45 is the owner in fee of certain land,with a building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of NewYork,known as Lot 45 on Block 6805 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,and as and by the street addresses 2221-2223 Avenue R,Brooklyn,New York,and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner45 Land,” the building or buildings located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future is herein collectively referred to as the “Owner45 Building,” and the Owner45 Land and the Owner45 Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner45 Parcel"). WHEREAS, Owner5O is the owner in fee of certain land, with buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as Lot 50 on Block 6805 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses 2205 and 2209 Avenue R, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner50 Land,” the building or buildings located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner50 Building,” and the Owner50 Land and the Owner50 Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner50 Parcel", and the Owner45 Parcel and the Owner50 Parcel are herein collectively referred to as the “Parcels,”" and separately as a "Parcel"). WHEREAS, Owner45 and Owner50 are sometimes referred to collectively as “Owner”or“Parties."” WHEREAS, the distinguishing ownership labels, Owner45 and Owner50, are used herein to differentiate between the two tax lots that comprise the Merged Zoning Lot as hereinafter defined. 1

WHEREAS,Owner45ParcelandOwner50Parcelwereheretoforepartofa single zoning lot and single tax lot, the former Lot 45, and were subsequently subdivided into separate tax lots which remain a single zoning lot under common ownership by Owner in its capacity as Owner45 and Owner50. WHEREAS, the former Lot 45,now collectively comprised of Lots 45 and 50, was declared to be a single zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot") as of July 27, 2007, when (i) an “Exhibit I, Certification of Zoning Lot" as executed by Sutton Land Title Agency, LLC was recorded in the Office of the Kings County Register under CRFN 2007000373548, and (i) an "Exhibit IHI, Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement’ as executed by Yeshivat Mikdash Melech was recorded in the Office of the Kings County Register under CRFN 2007000373547. The “Exhibit I, Certification of Zoning Lot” and “Exhibit IHl, Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement", together with this Agreement, are sometimes collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents." The Merged Zoning Lot is particularly described onExhibit“C" annexed hereto and made a part hereof. WHEREAS, Owner45 Parcel and Owner50 Parcel are contiguous for more than ten (1o) linear feet and are within a single tax block as required to create a single zoning lot pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"). Owner50Parcel into separate tax lots tofacilitate separate ownership of the Owner50 Building (which is presently two buildings and accessory structures), which action shall remain subject to conditions of this Agreement. WHEREAS, Owner45 and Owner50, pursuant to this Agreement, intend to establish a framework setting forth the rights and obligations of any future owners in connection with the maintenance and management of their respective parcels comprising the Merged Zoning Lot.
